title: The Dirty Dozen Exposed: How Pesticides on Food Affect Your Health
summary: Natural-remedies channel walks through the Dirty Dozen, linking residues on those foods to cancer, hormone and neurological harm, and recommends organic or a baking-soda soak.

assertions.quote: 12 foods that are consistently found to carry the highest levels of pesticide residue
consuming foods with high level of pesticide residue can increase the risk of hormonal imbalances fertility issues and even neurological disorders
glyphosate which is frequently found on kale and leafy greens has been linked to an increased risk of Non-Hodgkins Lymphoma
organic produce is grown without the use of synthetic pesticides significantly reducing your risk of ingesting harmful chemicals
baking soda for 15 minutes as this has been shown to be especially effective in removing external pesticides
